description: Team Harness deterministic-deny safety hooks for POSIX and Windows Codex. Native Codex permissions own approval prompts; review/trust is required before these hooks are active.

hooks.command: plugin_root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; hook_runner=""; case "$plugin_root" in /*) case "$plugin_root" in /|*/../*|*/./*|*/..|*/.) ;; *) direct_runner="$plugin_root/hooks/run-codex-hook.sh"; [ -f "$direct_runner" ] && [ ! -L "$direct_runner" ] && hook_runner="$direct_runner";; esac;; esac; if [ -z "$hook_runner" ]; then case "$plugin_root" in /*/plugins/cache/team-harness/team-harness/*) cache_parent="${plugin_root%/*}"; case "$cache_parent" in /*/plugins/cache/team-harness/team-harness) if [ -d "$cache_parent" ] && [ ! -L "$cache_parent" ]; then best_runner=""; for candidate_runner in "$cache_parent"/*/hooks/run-codex-hook.sh; do candidate_hooks="${candidate_runner%/*}"; candidate_root="${candidate_hooks%/*}"; candidate_manifest="$candidate_root/.codex-plugin/plugin.json"; [ -d "$candidate_root" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_root" ] || continue; [ -d "$candidate_hooks" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_hooks" ] || continue; [ -f "$candidate_runner" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_runner" ] || continue; [ -f "$candidate_manifest" ] && [ ! -L "$candidate_manifest" ] || continue; candidate_version="${candidate_root##*/}"; node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=process.argv[1],v=process.argv[2];try{const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));process.exit(d.name==="team-harness"&&d.version===v?0:1)}catch{process.exit(1)}' "$candidate_manifest" "$candidate_version" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; if [ -z "$best_runner" ] || [ "$candidate_runner" -nt "$best_runner" ]; then best_runner="$candidate_runner"; fi; done; hook_runner="$best_runner"; fi;; esac;; esac; fi; if [ -z "$hook_runner" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"team-harness Codex hooks unavailable: plugin runtime missing — reinstall or update the plugin; native Codex permissions remain the active boundary"}'; exit 0; fi; exec bash "$hook_runner" policy-block
hooks.commandWindows: for %N in (node.exe) do (if "%~$PATH:N"=="" (echo {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by team-harness Codex hook adapter: node runtime missing or launcher execution failed"}}) else ("%~$PATH:N" -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');const r=process.env.PLUGIN_ROOT||process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT;let t;try{if(!r||!p.isAbsolute(r)||p.resolve(r)===p.parse(r).root||r.split(/[\\/]/).some(x=>x==='.'||x==='..'))throw 0;const h=p.join(r,'hooks'),d=p.join(h,'dist');t=p.join(d,'codex-launcher.cjs');for(const x of [r,h,d]){const s=fs.lstatSync(x);if(!s.isDirectory()||s.isSymbolicLink())throw 0}const s=fs.lstatSync(t);if(!s.isFile()||s.isSymbolicLink())throw 0}catch{console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:'team-harness Codex hooks unavailable: plugin runtime missing - reinstall or update the plugin; native Codex permissions remain the active boundary'}));process.exit(0)}try{const m=require(t);if(typeof m.run!=='function')throw 0;m.run(process.argv.slice(1))}catch{console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason:'Blocked by team-harness Codex hook adapter: launcher execution failed'}}))}" policy-block & if errorlevel 1 echo {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by team-harness Codex hook adapter: node runtime missing or launcher execution failed"}}))
